items.name: defensive-asset-allocation
items.description: A momentum strategy with built-in crash protection using breadth-momentum of a canary universe

items.name: vhedge-risk-allocation-demo
items.description: Synthetic defensive multi-asset allocation and volatility targeting demo.

items.name: cross-asset-balanced-allocation-strategy
items.description: Cross-asset balanced allocation (SPY/TLT) with correlation-regime trigger to a defensive sleeve (cash + gold/silver), next-day open execution backtest, turnover/cost tracking, and volatility-adaptive drift bands optimized for net-of-cost Sharpe with stress tests (GFC/COVID/corr shocks).

items.name: AdaptiveDefensiveAllocator
items.description: AdaptiveDefensiveAllocator is a tactical asset allocation strategy combining equities (Top 30 US by market cap + momentum filter) with dynamic shifts into defensive ETFs (BIL, gold, bonds, sectors, optional inverse ETFs). It rebalances monthly with weekly defensive checks, using ATR-based stop-loss for downside protection.  2019–2025 backtest: CAGR

items.name: Tactical-Momentum-with-Defensive-Overlay
items.description: Momentum-based tactical allocation with defensive overlay. Backtest 2019–2025: CAGR ~35%, Max DD ~18%, Sharpe ~1.3. From QuantConnect community.  Research repo for multi-asset momentum strategy with defensive overlay. Includes code, backtest results, and annotations.

items.name: Dynamic-Portfolio-Allocation-Using-Oil-Volatility-Regimes
items.description: Regime-switching portfolio strategy using Brent crude oil volatility (GARCH + squared-return) to dynamically allocate between global equity and defensive assets — backtested on Bloomberg data (1990–2026).

items.name: macro-regime-allocation
items.description: Macro regime–based analysis of equity risk allocation using lagged economic indicators. Evaluates volatility, drawdowns, recovery dynamics, transaction costs, and defensive asset choice to assess macro regimes as a practical risk management framework rather than a return forecasting model.

items.name: Market-Regime-Detection-with-Hidden-Markov-Models-and-Regime-Based-Portfolio-Allocation
items.description: This project identifies hidden market regimes using a Hidden Markov Model trained on returns, volatility, and drawdowns. The detected regimes are used to implement a dynamic portfolio allocation strategy that adjusts exposure between risky and defensive assets depending on market conditions and risk levels.
